p3g1.instruction: Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS for each answer. Write your answers in boxes 27-32.
p3g1.body: Desertification flow-chart. Start: productive land (acted on by multiple causes). Next: degradation proceeds at [[27]]. This leads to: DESERTIFICATION. Desertification branches into two boxes: (a) [[28]] a climate trend, and (b) [[29]] a change in climate. Both lead to: resulting in greater [[30]]. This leads to two results: depletion of [[31]], and depletion of [[32]].
